title: TAIJI: Textual Anchoring for Immunizing Jailbreak Images in Vision Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on immunizing Vision Language Models (VLMs) against jailbreak attacks to ensure they generate safe, ethical, and morally aligned content. It evaluates its defense mechanism using safety benchmarks like MM-SafetyBench, which categorize harmful content into 13 safety-critical scenarios related to societal values and ethics.
